Bug drafts (not filed)

D8High

Automatic customer emails: no acknowledgements, and the closing email has no rating link

Cases
W4-09, W4-28, W4-73
Where
Setup › Channels › Email › Replies (acknowledgement on); Setup › Email Templates (reply acknowledgement); Setup › Customer Happiness (send on close)

Steps

  1. Make sure the acknowledgement is on (Email › Replies) and a reply-acknowledgement template is active for the department.
  2. From a customer mailbox, email the support address to open a new ticket, then reply to the agent's answer.
  3. Turn ratings on for the department with Send on close, and close the ticket.

Expected

The customer gets "Your ticket has been delivered…" for the new ticket, the reply acknowledgement after their reply, and a closing email that carries the rating question with Good / Okay / Bad links (TAVI's own setup text says the Ticket Closed email carries the rating link when ratings are sent on close).

Actual

For tickets #3278, #3279, #3280 and the reply on #3280, no acknowledgement email arrived. Closing #3280 twice (23:11 and 23:16 Cairo) with ratings on for Marketing sent the closing email without any rating question or link. Agent replies on the same tickets were delivered.

Request and response (from the run, ids shortened)

Closing email received (both closes):
  Your ticket #3280 "QA GL W4 mail to new address" has been closed. If you need anything else, just reply to this email.
  Wonder Travel · 09876543210 · 1, Maadi, Cairo, EG · https://crm.taviportal.com/
Settings at the time: acknowledgement_enabled=true; happiness is_enabled=true, trigger=on_close, department scope = Marketing

Zoho Desk

Zoho Desk has notification rules for acknowledging a new ticket and a new reply (Zoho help: Notifications). Not checked live in Zoho (it would need test data in the Zoho account, which is read only). This is TAVI failing its own feature, so no Zoho comparison is needed to call it a bug.

Evidence

Closing email text (evidence/raw/w4/W4-73-closing-mail.txt), close dialog below. Small extra: the footer link points to the live site crm.taviportal.com from staging.

D1Medium

Email domains: bad values are saved, others get "try again" instead of a validation message

Cases
W4-08
Where
Setup › Channels › Email › Your domains › Add domain

Steps

  1. Add domain "http://x.com".
  2. Add domain "exa mple.com" (with a space).
  3. Add domain "abc", then add a domain that is already in the list.
  4. Remove one of the bad domains.

Expected

Invalid values are refused with a clear message; a duplicate says it already exists; Remove removes it.

Actual

"http://x.com" is saved as http:%2f%2fx.com and "exa mple.com" is saved, both waiting for DNS proof. "abc" and the duplicate get 503 "our side, please try again". Remove only marks the domain retired, so the junk stays listed.

Zoho Desk

Not checked live in Zoho (it would need test data in the Zoho account, which is read only). This is TAVI failing its own feature, so no Zoho comparison is needed to call it a bug.

Evidence

Domains page during the run.

D9Medium

A department reply-acknowledgement template cannot be switched off or deleted

Cases
W4-28 (cleanup)
Where
Setup › Email Templates

Steps

  1. Create a reply-acknowledgement template for one department (Marketing) and Activate it.
  2. Open its Actions menu, then the built-in Reply acknowledgement's Actions menu.
  3. Try to Delete your template.

Expected

A way to go back to the built-in template for that department (Deactivate, or Activate on the built-in), then Delete works.

Actual

Your template's menu shows Activate (as if not active). The built-in's Activate is greyed out: "This template is already the one being sent." There is no Deactivate. Delete is refused: "This template is the one being sent. Activate another template, or the built-in one, before…". The template is stuck.

Zoho Desk

Not checked live in Zoho (it would need test data in the Zoho account, which is read only). This is TAVI failing its own feature, so no Zoho comparison is needed to call it a bug.

Evidence

API: DELETE /desk/email-templates/{id} → 422 UNPROCESSABLE (above); POST …/system.ticket.reply_acknowledgement/activate {department_id} → 200 but nothing changes.

D7Medium

Community question topics do not become tickets (Zoho creates a linked ticket)

Cases
W4-58
Where
Help Center › Community › customer posts a Question; Desk › Community topic

Steps

  1. Signed in on the Help Center, post a topic of type Question in a category.
  2. In Desk, open the topic (Community) and look for its ticket, or a Convert to ticket action.

Expected

Like Zoho: a ticket is created and linked to the question (Ticket ID on the topic; on the ticket a Forum Status field and Post Reply back to the forum).

Actual

No ticket is created (topic API returns ticket: null) and the topic Tools menu has no Convert to ticket (sticky, lock, move, moderate, open in Help Center, delete; API can.convert = false).

Zoho Desk

Checked live on 13 Nov (test topic created with your OK, then deleted and purged): posting "QA GL W4 zoho topic" as a Question created ticket #190 at once. The topic shows "Ticket ID: #190"; the ticket shows the topic text, a Forum Status field and Post Reply to the forum; after the topic was deleted the ticket said "Forum topic has been deleted".

Evidence

Zoho topic with Ticket ID, and the linked Zoho ticket.

D2Low

Blocked addresses accept a wildcard (*@example.com)

Cases
W4-13
Where
Setup › Channels › Email › Blocked addresses

Steps

  1. Block "*@example.com".

Expected

Either refused (the page says "Desk blocks one address at a time, not a whole domain") or a real domain block.

Actual

"*@example.com" is accepted and listed as blocked, with no hint of what it does.

Zoho Desk

Zoho Desk's Allowlist and Blocklist blocks emails and domains ("tickets from blocked emails and domains will be restricted and marked as spam"). So domain blocking is expected; TAVI should support it properly or refuse the wildcard.

Evidence

TAVI list and Zoho Allowlist and Blocklist page.

Gaps against Zoho found in this wave

  • Community categories cannot be deleted in TAVI (only Edit, Lock, Disable).
  • Notes, not bugs: a 300-character subject is cut to 255 silently; the Overview tab's address count was out of date; Arabic dir is dropped on the KB portal paragraph; every KB version shows the same time; a reply sent from the portal shows only after reload; the email template subject is not applied to a reply (keeps Re:); no message after a translation import or Save on Customer Happiness.
  • Built since the inventory: Help widgets (N-16 was listed Missing). The web form script embed works when the site is in allowed origins, so NDC-2751 may be fixed.

Known Plane tickets

  • Known and still open: NDC-1488 (web form hosted link nginx 404, W4-34). NDC-2751 (script embed) looks fixed (W4-35). O-08: a second Help Center is refused and own domain is Coming soon (NDC-2760 list holds).

Inconclusive and not run

  • W4-12: the live part of blocking needs a mailbox that never wrote to support (both test mailboxes have open tickets from other tests). Add/remove block works.
  • W4-19: SMTP skipped by you at Gate 1.
  • W4-72: Customer Happiness setup was changed by another session during the run; ratings were tested by switching it on for Marketing for a few minutes and back.
  • W4-74..W4-78: blocked by D8 (no rating link to click).
  • W4-46: the portal URL part passed; the public-API part (calling another customer's ticket with the customer's sign-in) was not run from here.
